findings.title: Dashboard sales/orders endpoints under-report vs DB
findings.details: GET /api/admin/dashboard/total-orders returns 0 today and GET /api/admin/dashboard/sales-summary returns '0,00 €' BUT direct DB query on orders.created_at>=today returns 1 row with total=7.80€ (kiosk source_surface). Two peer endpoints (realtime-report + order-statistics) DO see the order. Owner reading dashboard tonight sees '0 commandes / 0€' on those widgets while a real borne sale happened.
findings.impact: Owner cannot trust EOD dashboard for daily totals; manager risk of mis-decisioning (e.g. flagging the day as 'no sales').
findings.fix_hint: Audit DashboardController total-orders + sales-summary status/payment_status filters — likely require payment_status=15 (settled) AND order status in (delivered set) — current order 63 is status=4 (accepted) which is excluded. Align all 4 widgets to the same filter set OR document semantics in tooltip.

findings.title: Taux abandon panier borne — métrique non instrumentée
findings.details: Mission asks 'Taux abandon panier borne ?' — V1 has NO data source for this. orders.payment_status<10 filter returns 0 today but this only captures POSTed orders that failed payment, not abandoned wizard sessions before submit. No cart_drafts/wizard_sessions table exists. No frontend analytics event to backend. Owner cannot get this metric from current dashboard.
findings.impact: Owner-night review of borne effectiveness blocked on this question. Common SaaS KPI missing.
findings.fix_hint: V1.0.X backlog: either (a) lightweight client-side beacon on wizard step-out → action_logs insert OR (b) wizard_sessions ephemeral table with start_ts/last_step_ts/abandoned_at. (a) is cheap and aligns with existing action_logs Kiosk event pattern.

findings.title: Phase F2 SmsBornePending event = ABSENT (phantom)
findings.details: Mission task line 4 says 'Verify Phase F2 SmsBornePending event presence/absence'. After grep -rE on full codebase (app/, resources/, tests/, migrations): ZERO matches. app/Events/ contains NO event with 'Borne' substring. Phase F2 in this codebase refers to NF525 REFUND/REMBOURSEMENT marker work (confirmed via PROJECT_BRAIN.md proposals section), NOT borne SMS. The mission name 'SmsBornePending' appears to be a phantom — never landed, never planned.
findings.impact: If a parent agent or roadmap expects this event for owner-night borne pickup notification, that pipeline does not exist. Possibly conflated with the planned (but unbuilt) borne pickup SMS path.
findings.fix_hint: Clarify upstream what was meant. If borne pickup SMS is needed, design as new event (e.g. KioskOrderReadyForPickup) wired to SendOrderGotSms listener + sms_gateways config — sms_gateways table exists but has 0 rows so any SMS path is currently inert anyway.

findings.title: Stock-rupture dashboard cron disabled → 'no data' renders identically to 'no rupture'
findings.details: /admin/stock/scan-rupture/last-summary returns cron_enabled=false + summary=null for branch_id=1. UI likely renders this state similarly to 'no rupture detected'. Owner-night may interpret null as 'all good' when in reality scan never ran today.
findings.impact: False-confidence risk for owner. Operationally also disconnects the rupture dashboard from real stock-level state (cross-checked DB has 0 ruptures today, so coincidentally accurate, but it would still appear clean even if there WERE ruptures).
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) re-enable STOCK_RUPTURE_CRON for production owner-night UX OR (b) explicit UI badge 'Scan rupture désactivé — donnée non rafraîchie' when cron_enabled=false.
